findings.evidence: The delta spec at openspec/changes/requirement-project-membership/specs/managed-task-intake/spec.md:5 requires that an existing Status SHALL NOT be overwritten. template/scripts/managed_project_status.py:427-435 reads Status and then unconditionally writes Backlog when that earlier read was unset. A concurrent claim between those operations is overwritten; the read-back at lines 437-442 accepts the resulting Backlog. A read-only mocked interleaving reproduced In progress being replaced by Backlog with a successful receipt.
findings.summary: Status initialization can overwrite a concurrent claim and still report success.

findings.evidence: template/docs/engineering/chatgpt-project-protocol.md:86-88 makes fixation success conditional on an item with its initial Backlog Status; docs/engineering/chatgpt-project-protocol.md:232-233 and template/docs/engineering/task-intake.md.jinja:31-33 repeat this condition. The delta spec at openspec/changes/requirement-project-membership/specs/managed-task-intake/spec.md:5 and :14-16 instead requires an initialized Status and preservation of an existing one. A reused item already showing In progress satisfies that contract but fails the documented Backlog-only success condition.
findings.summary: Connected and template guidance incorrectly requires Backlog when reusing an initialized item.
